VideoAiSegmentGate.title: VideoAiSegmentGate
VideoAiSegmentGate.description:
When the verdict is not AI side, Likely AI segments and AI segments shorter than ``min_ai_ms`` are shown as
Unsure (neighbouring segments with the same label merge), and the verdict follows the displayed segments.

VideoMixedDisplay.title: VideoMixedDisplay
VideoMixedDisplay.description:
Heatmap-Mixed frames at most ``max_gap_frames`` ordinary frames apart form a cluster; clusters spanning fewer than
``min_cluster_frames`` frames are shown as ordinary frames, and so is all Mixed when what remains covers less than
``min_share`` of the video's frames. On the displayed timeline an ordinary stretch of at most ``max_gap_frames`` frames
between two Mixed segments is shown as Mixed too, while the verdict counts the timeline before that filling.

VideoSmoothing.title: VideoSmoothing
VideoSmoothing.description: Describes the HMM smoother applied to a result; the parameters are fitted and reported for transparency.
